signal: VertexOne secured a $131M financing commitment and acquired Accelerated Innovations to expand its utility customer-engagement platform

email.body1:
Charlie, saw VertexOne landed a $131M financing commitment and folded in Accelerated Innovations to widen the platform.

That kind of capital and a new acquisition usually means more utility accounts in play than the regional team can cover before territories settle, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for VertexOne off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Charlie, quick follow-up for VertexOne.

After a raise this size, the number jumps faster than headcount can. Most regional teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings VertexOne needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Charlie, last bit of proof for VertexOne.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how VertexOne's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Charlie, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem. The post-financing, post-acquisition stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional utility motion? I'll tailor it to VertexOne either way.
